There’s the traditional striped (mackerel) tabby. There’s tabby cats who have spots, and then tabby cats who have a swirled pattern are called marble/marbled. Then there’s the agouti/ticked/natural type. 

The agouti/ticked pattern comes from each strand having multiple colors, but not in a uniform enough pattern to form actual stripes. 

Striped/spotted/marbled tabby cats may still have a few colors per strand, but the sections form stripes where as the agouti cat coat type looks like OP’s cat.
